---
title: "About"
---

I am a doctoral researcher in linguistics at the University of Wrocław (since October 2026), interested in how language structures interpretations of political and social reality. My work draws on cognitive linguistics, corpus-assisted discourse studies, and discourse analysis.

## Research interests

- Cognitive linguistics and Text World Theory
- Corpus-assisted discourse studies
- Political and legislative discourse
- Conceptual metaphor and translation
- Reproducible computational methods for linguistic research

## Academic affiliation

**Doctoral researcher**, University of Wrocław (since October 2026).

## Education

**MA in English Studies**, University of Wrocław (2026)  
**BA in English Studies**, University of Wrocław (2024)

## Research approach

I combine corpus evidence with contextual interpretation. This site documents research questions, methods, publications, and selected practical projects.
